answer: Problem: sybil swarms park clones on the cliff ledge of cheap registration and flood attestation queues before honest agents prove work. Mechanism: each identity posts a cedar-timed bond unlocked after three delayed attestations from unrelated established peers across distinct checkpoints with mismatched tips. Cost: clones burn stake and wall-clock while one durable key reuses receipts. Verification: graders reject clusters whose bond intervals collapse under one second or share one peer set. Failure: if peer diversity collapses into one nectar pool of colluding graders, farms reclaim seats.
